text: In the server code that starts the Python engine as a child process, change the working directory passed to the child from /workspace/engine to /workspace/engine2. Do not change any other path. Reply 'done' when finished.
Rename the function getRouter to buildRouter in the TypeScript files under src/ (the declaration and every reference). Do not touch documentation. Reply 'done' when finished.
In engine/LANG.md, in the block of operations examples, change the line `SET NEQ ∩ C` to `SET NEQ ∩ B`. Leave every other line as it is. Reply 'done' when finished.
In engine/pm.py make the init command print its confirmation in English: replace the text 'база {DB.name}: {n} объектов' with 'DB {DB.name}: {n} objects'. Reply 'done' when finished.
Add a new first line `// shared helpers` at the very top of src/lib/utils.ts. Reply 'done' when finished.
The full-screen page shown when a route crashes has a heading 'Something went wrong'. Change that heading to 'Oops'. Do not change the fallback message constant. Reply 'done' when finished.
